description: Latest reviewed attempt per case/arm, including failures. Raw exports are local-only. Each case keeps one flat baseline and one flat current run; client/transport identity stays in this index and comparison notes.

measurement_notes.unit: One preserved natural-prompt case per arm; case 05 includes its requested revision.
measurement_notes.model_tool_round: One top-level recorded function_call or custom_tool_call; an exec may contain several parallel or sequential MCP calls.
measurement_notes.discovery_round: Metadata-only ALL_TOOLS inspection, classified from recorded call input; included in model_tool_rounds.
measurement_notes.wall_time: Sum of first task prompt to final assistant answer per task turn (or abort timestamp for interrupted turns); excludes between-turn idle time, includes in-turn retries/waits and steering.
measurement_notes.tokens: Sum token_usage_record payload.usage for task turns before first export request; uncached_input=input-cached; reasoning_output is included in output, not added twice.
measurement_notes.export: Native transcript remains immutable; export request, export tools, and export-token usage excluded.
measurement_notes.call_count_limit: No aggregate MCP or upstream HTTP count inferred from literal call-name occurrences; loops/batches and adapter-internal reads make them different measures.
measurement_notes.confidence: Single practical pair per case; combined changes and mutable workspace, not randomized attribution or a performance SLA.
measurement_notes.mcp_tool_seconds: Sum recorded durations of unique completed Lagniappe McpToolCall items, including imported app calls/errors; parallel durations may overlap and may exclude approval waits. Not elapsed time or isolated network latency.
measurement_notes.confirmed_uploaded_files: Unique files confirmed in finalization/authoritative Plan inventory, not attempted HTTP requests; zero when no upload was attempted.
measurement_notes.remote_arm: codex-remote records this remote pilot separately from local mcp history. Per-case transport and mcp_routes identify imported ChatGPT-app exceptions; do not infer every call used direct Codex OAuth.
